title: Head of Commercial
description:
**Position : Head – Commercial**

**Department - Commercial**

**Location – Manufacturing Plant, Sanand.**

**Reports to – CEO**

**Role Overview :**

Head – Commercial will lead the end-to-end commercial function for the organization, driving pricing strategy, distribution excellence, customer partnerships, regulatory compliance, tendering, and order management across domestic and international markets. The role is critical in ensuring profitability, market competitiveness, and adherence to stringent medical device regulations.

**Key Responsibilities :**

**Commercial Strategy & Leadership**

* Define and execute the overall commercial strategy aligned with business growth objectives
* Lead cross-functional alignment across sales, finance, supply chain, regulatory, and operations
* Drive revenue growth, margin expansion, and market penetration

**Pricing Strategy & Governance**

* Develop pricing frameworks considering regulatory caps (if applicable), reimbursement structures, and competitive landscape
* Ensure compliance with pricing regulations in domestic and export markets
* Drive margin optimization through structured pricing reviews and cost analysis

**Distribution & Channel Management**

* Design and optimize distribution networks including distributors, dealers, and institutional channels (hospitals, government bodies)
* Ensure efficient logistics, inventory control, and demand planning
* Evaluate and onboard channel partners with strong governance mechanisms

**Customer & Key Account Management**

* Build and manage relationships with key stakeholders including hospitals, healthcare providers, and institutional buyers
* Lead commercial negotiations, contracts, and long-term agreements
* Drive customer satisfaction, retention, and service excellence

**Regulatory Compliance & Governance**

* Ensure adherence to medical device regulations (e.g., CDSCO, ISO standards, and international regulatory requirements)
* Oversee compliance in contracts, pricing, and commercial practices
* Collaborate with regulatory and quality teams to ensure audit readiness

**Tendering & Institutional Business**

* Lead strategy and execution for government and private tenders
* Ensure competitive, compliant, and profitable bid submissions
* Manage GeM portal participation and large institutional contracts

**Order Management (Domestic & Export)**

* Oversee end-to-end order lifecycle from order booking to delivery and payment realization
* Ensure compliance with export regulations, documentation, and international trade

terms (Incoterms)

* Coordinate with supply chain and logistics for timely fulfilment.

**Financial & Risk Management**

* Own commercial P&L elements including revenue, margins, and working capital
* Monitor receivables, credit policies, and financial exposure
* Identify and mitigate commercial and contractual risks

title: Growth Manager
description:
Swiggy is India’s leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
  
  
**Job Description**
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants learning their business understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
  
  
**Job Description:**

* Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
* Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
* Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
* Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
* Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
* Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
* Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Google sheet/WSP
* Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction 80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month

**Qualifications**
Graduate
  
  
**Additional Information**
**Experience & Background:**

* 0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
* Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
* Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partners.
* Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
* Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

**Visit our tech blogs to learn more about some the challenges we deal with: https://medium.com/swiggy-bytes**
**We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by the law.**

**Designation: Manager/ Sr. Manager – Carrier & Freight Commercial**

**Location: Gandhinagar**

**Role purpose**

This position owns the commercial relationship with every carrier the business uses — rate negotiation, lane allocation, contract renewal and freight cost assurance. It sits directly under the Head of Supply Chain & Logistics and is separate from trade and customs compliance, which is a distinct function. The role carries a monthly express freight spend running in the order of 23 crore, against which no contracted rate table currently exists for the India entities.

**Key responsibilities**

* Own every carrier contract end to end — FedEx across both India entities and the US entity, UPS, Emirates and new entrants — including a renewal and expiry calendar with a named owner against every date, so that no term lapses unnoticed.
* Negotiate and benchmark rates, and build the rate card baseline the business does not currently hold. Roughly 89% of monthly freight spend is un-baselined today.
* Own lane allocation — routing volume to the right carrier by cost, transit time and service level — and document the logic so it can be audited and repeated.
* Govern dimensional divisors, fuel and surcharge concessions across all carriers, including the US amendment concessions that expire in February 2027 and revert to list.
* Own freight cost assurance — charged weight against company record, invoice audit before payment, and recovery claims through to credit.
* Drive down accessorial and exception charges by working with operations on root cause, not only by validating them after billing.
* Monitor volume commitments and surge clauses against contractual thresholds, and flag a breach before the carrier does.
* Run carrier governance — quarterly business reviews, SLA reviews, escalation matrices and service remedies.
* Report carrier cost monthly into the business review and into the gross margin programme.
* Support the trade and customs compliance function on carrier-side documentation, without owning compliance itself.

**Required skills, qualifications and experience**

* 10 to 14 years in freight procurement, carrier management or logistics commercial, with direct hands-on negotiation with international express carriers.
* Demonstrated contract negotiation on an annual freight spend of 100 crore or above.
* Deep working knowledge of express pricing mechanics — dimensional divisors, fuel tables, accessorial structures, zone and lane pricing, earned discount tiers and volume commitments.
* Freight audit and recovery experience, including building and defending a claim against a carrier.
* Strong commercial analytics — able to build a cost model, defend it to Finance, and put it in front of a carrier without it being picked apart.
* Exposure across air, ocean and parcel modes; export-led businesses preferred.
* Able to hold a senior carrier relationship and a difficult commercial conversation without damaging it.
* Graduate. MBA or postgraduate qualification in Supply Chain, or CIPS or equivalent procurement certification, an advantage.

**What good looks like in the first 90 days**

* A complete rate card and contract baseline across every carrier, in one register.
* A renewal and expiry calendar with a named owner against each date, including the February 2027 surcharge cliff.
* The open recovery claim either closed or on an agreed, dated path with the carrier.
* Lane allocation logic documented and agreed with operations.
* A first view of accessorial spend by type, with the three largest reduction opportunities quantified.

title: Horeca Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Alisha Snacks Pvt Ltd is a fast-growing FMCG company founded by Mr. Barkat Velani with a mission to provide healthy and hygienic snacks at affordable prices across India. The company has built well-known snack brands such as TARGET & SCHOOL TIME and pioneered the packaged snacks concept in the Gujarat region. With strong presence in Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Maharashtra, and Chhattisgarh, the business has achieved significant sales growth and is targeting further expansion. Alisha Snacks is now focused on building TARGET & SCHOOLTIME into a major national brand, supported by a growing distribution network. The company is also expanding its manufacturing capacity and launching new flavors in chips and namkeen using advanced automated technology.

**Role Description**
The Horeca Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in Anand, responsible for managing and growing business in the Hotel, Restaurant, and Café (HORECA) segment. The Horeca Manager will oversee relationships with key hospitality and foodservice partners, ensuring excellent service levels, product availability, and timely resolution of issues. Daily tasks include visiting HORECA clients, presenting product ranges, negotiating pricing and contracts, and coordinating orders with the sales and supply chain teams. The role involves monitoring market trends, gathering feedback on products, supporting promotional activities, and identifying new business opportunities. The Horeca Manager will also train partner staff on product features and hygiene standards, prepare performance reports, and collaborate with internal teams to drive volume and brand visibility in the HORECA channel.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, including the ability to build relationships and negotiate effectively with HORECA partners.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to manage client expectations, resolve issues promptly, and maintain high satisfaction levels.
* Candidates should possess Food & Beverage knowledge, with familiarity in snack products, HORECA operations, and basic food safety and hygiene standards.
* Candidates should possess Hospitality experience, ideally within hotels, restaurants, cafés, or foodservice distribution environments.
* Candidates should possess Training skills to educate partner staff on products, merchandising, and service practices.
* Relevant experience in FMCG sales or HORECA business development, with a track record of meeting targets, is highly beneficial.
* Strong planning, territory management, and reporting skills, with ability to use MS Office and basic sales tools.
* Diploma or degree in Hospitality Management, Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred.
* Ability to work on-site in Anand, travel within the region, and adapt to a dynamic, growth-oriented environment.

title: Assistant General Manager
description:
**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* International Sales Coordination & Commercial Operations
* Lead the International Sales Coordination team: define roles, workflows, turnaround times and KPIs, and review performance with coaching.
* Ensure timely review and confirmation of international customer POs against approved quotations, prices, payment terms and customer agreements, and relay accurate requirements (specifications, quantities, packaging, labelling, delivery schedules) to International Sales.
* Ensure orders, amendments, cancellations and revised delivery schedules are recorded in the ERP system and tracked from confirmation to post-shipment closure (production status, shipment readiness, delivery commitments).
* Monitor order backlogs, delayed orders and shipment priorities; resolve issues on specifications, packaging, quantities and invoicing; and escalate delivery risks and bottlenecks in time.
* Keep customers updated on order confirmations, production progress, shipment schedules and delays, and streamline communication between the sales coordination team and Production Planning, Manufacturing, Quality, Packaging, Dispatch, Logistics and Finance for timely execution.
* Support International Sales with customer reviews, visits, inspections, business planning and account servicing.
* Oversee and finalise pricing and code creation for new products in the sales pipeline.
* Coordinate with Sales and Finance on pricing approvals, credit limits, outstanding receivables and commercial discrepancies.
* Customer Complaints & Service Excellence
* Own end-to-end complaint management for international and domestic customers (acknowledgement, resolution timelines, investigation, closure) through a structured tracking system covering quality, breakage, defects, shortages, packaging, labelling, documentation and shipment delays.
* Coordinate RCA and CAPA with the concerned departments, ensure timely and accurate investigation reports, and hold periodic review meetings with departmental heads to drive accountability and feed lessons learned into SOPs and improvements in quality, packaging, documentation and delivery reliability.
* Monitor complaint ageing, pending actions, repeat complaints and closure timelines, and escalate critical, recurring or high-impact issues and commercial disputes to senior management while protecting the company’s commercial interests.
* Set service standards for customer communication and complaint handling to build customer confidence, retention and repeat business.
* EXIM Department Management
* Oversee EXIM operations: accurate export and import documentation (invoices, packing lists, shipping bills, BL/AWB, certificates), document control and audit readiness, and coordination with customs brokers, freight forwarders and shipping lines for timely shipment and clearance.
* Ensure compliance with customs laws, Foreign Trade Policy, DGFT and GST, including licences, duty benefits, export-linked schemes and renewals, and coordinate with Finance on export proceeds realisation and e-BRC.
* Monitor shipping costs (freight, demurrage, detention) and optimise shipment planning and container utilisation.
* MIS, Reporting & Process Governance
* Present periodic MIS and dashboards to management (order status and backlog, on-time shipments, complaints with RCA/CAPA status, shipment status, documentation accuracy, freight and avoidable costs, export proceeds, team productivity), analyse trends and close process gaps.
* Develop and review SOPs with escalation matrices, ownership, SLAs and process controls, and drive digitalisation and effective use of ERP.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Graduate in Commerce, Business Administration, International Business, Supply Chain Management or a related discipline.
* MBA / PGDM in International Business, Operations or Supply Chain (added advantage).
* Certification in Export-Import Management, International Trade or Logistics (preferred).

**Experience**

* 10-15 years in international sales coordination, export commercial operations, customer services or EXIM management, including international customer handling, export documentation, shipment coordination and complaint resolution.
* 3-5 years leading teams or managing multiple functions.
* Experience coordinating with international buyers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, shipping lines and financial institutions.
* Experience in ceramic, porcelain, tableware, homeware or another export-oriented manufacturing organisation (preferred).

**Behavioural & Leadership Competencies**

* Strong team leadership and people management.
* Excellent written and verbal business English.
* Customer orientation, stakeholder management, cross-functional collaboration and conflict resolution.
* Analytical thinking, structured problem-solving and decision-making.
* Attention to detail, accuracy and compliance discipline.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, tight deadlines and customer escalations.
* Ownership, accountability, integrity and continuous improvement.

title: CSM
description:
**Company Description** 
 Vidya Wires is one of India’s largest manufacturers and exporters of enameled copper wire, with over 40 years of industry experience. Based in Gujarat, the company produces a wide range of copper products, including wires, wire strips, paper\-covered strips and wires, and copper tapes. Vidya Wires focuses on building long\-term relationships by consistently delivering superior quality products and welcoming client feedback to drive continuous improvement. The company operates with strong ethical standards, earning a trusted reputation in the copper wire sector. Its strength lies in a skilled and experienced workforce committed to meeting challenges while ensuring quality and timely delivery.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Customer Success Manager (CSM) role based in Nadiad. The CSM will manage and nurture client relationships, ensuring that customers receive high\-quality service and support throughout their engagement with Vidya Wires. Daily responsibilities include understanding client requirements, coordinating with production and logistics teams, monitoring order status, and proactively addressing issues related to quality, delivery, and documentation. The role involves conducting regular check\-ins with clients, gathering feedback, and translating it into actionable improvements for internal teams. The CSM will also prepare reports, maintain accurate records, support onboarding of new clients, and contribute to process optimization that enhances customer satisfaction and retention.
   

**Qualifications**
* Customer relationship and account management skills, including the ability to build trust, handle client queries, and manage expectations.
* Communication and interpersonal skills for clear verbal and written interactions with clients and internal teams.
* Organizational and time\-management skills to oversee multiple accounts, follow up on deliveries, and maintain accurate documentation.
* Problem\-solving and analytical skills to understand client issues, identify root causes, and collaborate on effective solutions.
* Basic understanding of manufacturing operations and supply chain processes; experience in industrial or B2B environments is an advantage.
* Proficiency in common office software (e.g., spreadsheets, word processing, email) and ability to work with CRM or ERP tools.
* Relevant educational background in business, commerce, engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience in customer success or sales support will also be considered.
* Ability to work on\-site in Nadiad, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and maintain a client\-focused, ethical approach.
